# 修真太極混元指玄圖-1154)

**ID:** KR5a0151
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0151

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A nine-folio Sòng *nèidān* 內丹 ("inner alchemy") chart-text of the Zhōng Lǚ 鍾呂 tradition, comprising nine diagrams together with a collection of short formulas (*jué* 訣) — the *Mìchuán tāixī jué* 祕傳胎息訣 in five sections, the *Zhēn lónghǔ jiāogòu nèidān jué tú* 真龍虎交媾內丹訣圖, the *Mìchuán nèidān jué* 祕傳內丹訣 in seven sections (*zǐjīn dān*, *jīndān*, *lónghǔ nèidān*, *qīngjīn dān*, *hóngjīn dān*, *xīhuá dān*, *tàixuán dān*), the *Zhōutiān huǒhòu jué tú* 周天火候訣圖, and others. The treatise, like its companion *[DZ 149 Xiūzhēn tàijí hùnyuán tú](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0150)*, illustrates the methods set out in the *Xiūzhēn zhǐxuán piān* 修真指玄篇 of *[DZ 1017 Dàoshū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c1017)* 19.9a–22a, but supplies only the names of the techniques without practical instructions. Preserved in the *Zhèngtǒng Dàozàng* 正統道藏 (DZ 0150 / CT 150 = TC 150), 洞真部 靈圖類.

**Abstract**

Farzeen Baldrian-Hussein, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:804 (§3.A.4, *Nèidān* and *Yǎngshēng*), explains that Jīn Quánzǐ's preface, which the Dàozàng editors inadvertently bound at the start of [DZ 149](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0150), in fact belongs to the present work. A near-identical preface, with minor variations, is ascribed to Lǐ Sōng 李竦 — a disciple of Shī Jiānwú and the compiler of *[DZ 246 Xīshān qúnxiān huìzhēn jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0247)* — in *[DZ 1248 Sāndòng qúnxiān lù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1248)* 14.22a, a work dated 1154. Whereas Jīn places his encounter with Shī in *Nánjīng* simply, Lǐ has *Nánjīng Yīngtiān fǔ* 南京應天府, a name in use in 1008–1016 (*Dàzhōng xiángfú* 大中祥符 era). The present text can therefore be placed between this period and 1154. One Jīn Zhúpō 金竹坡 of the Táng (618–907) is named as the author of *[DZ 923 Dàdān qiāngōng lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0923)*, but that work is now recognised as a Southern Sòng forgery, and the present Jīn Quánzǐ should not be conflated with it. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 1008 / notAfter 1154.
